A self-described Chettinad UG alumnus writes that the ortho department is 'extremely toxic, sadistic and misogynistic' and that APs, professors and the former HOD were 'physically and verbally abusive and exploitative to the PGs'; a second ex-student describes heavy fines, phones banned, suspension for bunking, 5 pm hostel in-time for women and no leaving campus without parental permission.
